_meta.description: Called by the 'Appraisal Review Extractor' Copilot Studio agent. Accepts an appraisal review PDF (as a file input, not an HTTP upload — see trigger notes), extracts 17 credit-risk data points via an AI Builder prompt, copies the bank's own appraisal review template to a new, uniquely named workbook, writes the extracted values into that workbook's named cells (sheet 'RE Collateral'), and returns a link to the new file plus a summary to the agent.
_meta.invokedBy: Appraisal Review Extractor (Copilot Studio agent), via InvokeFlowAction — not called over HTTP by other flows/agents
connectors: AI Builder (shared_aibuilder) — Predict with a custom Prompt (see Deployment Configuration below)
SharePoint (shared_sharepointonline) — Copy file, Get file properties, Create sharing link — run on every request, this template creates a new file per review
Excel Online (Business) (shared_excelonlinebusiness) — Run script, to populate the named cells listed in _meta.cellMap
costNotes: No Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, or Azure Function is provisioned for this tool — extraction runs entirely on the AI Builder prompt included with the team's Power Platform/Copilot Studio capacity, so the only new consumption is AI Builder credits per PDF processed.

Cell population uses the standard Excel Online (Business) 'Run script' (Office Scripts) action, not a Premium connector or a custom Azure Function — Office Scripts are included in standard Microsoft 365 licensing.
The flow's own trigger is Copilot Studio's native child-flow trigger, not a Premium HTTP Request trigger.

The agent enforces a 15 MB / 40-page cap before calling this flow (see agent/appraisal-agent-instructions.md), so this flow never spends AI Builder credits — or creates a new file — for an oversized or clearly-invalid upload.

This version intentionally creates one new file per review (per the bank's existing review-package convention) rather than appending to a shared workbook — the template copy and the one-time sharing-link creation are the per-run costs this design accepts in exchange for matching the team's existing template/workflow.

trigger.description: Native 'When Copilot Studio calls a flow' trigger. No Premium HTTP Request trigger is used, so this flow does not require a Power Automate Premium license — only the connectors below (Excel Online (Business) and SharePoint are standard; AI Builder consumption is billed separately via AI Builder credits).

fileContent.description: The appraisal review PDF, passed as a File-type input from the agent's Attachment question (topic.AppraisalFile).

outputs.description: Configured on the trigger's Outputs panel in the designer (see DEPLOYMENT.md) — each output is bound to an expression pointing at the corresponding Compose action below.

Extract_With_AI_Builder.description: Calls the custom AI Builder Prompt 'Appraisal Review Field Extraction' (created once in AI Builder > Prompts, see DEPLOYMENT.md). The prompt takes the PDF as a File input variable and returns structured JSON matching the schema in agent/appraisal-agent-instructions.md — no separate OCR step or Azure Document Intelligence resource is needed for machine-readable PDFs.

Format_City_State.description: Feeds cell F24, which holds city and state together.

Build_Destination_File_Name.description: One new file per review: '<street address, sanitized> - <city state> - <yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>.xlsx'. The timestamp suffix guarantees uniqueness even for two reviews on the same property the same day.

Copy_Template_To_New_File.description: Copies the template designated in parameters.templateSiteUrl / parameters.templateFilePath to parameters.destinationSiteUrl / parameters.destinationFolderPath, under the name built above. 'If another file already exists' is set to Rename as a safety net, since the timestamp suffix already makes a collision very unlikely.

Get_New_File_Properties.description: Resolves the drive/item identifiers of the newly copied file from the path Copy_Template_To_New_File returns — the Run Script and Create Sharing Link actions need these identifiers, not just a path.

Populate_Review_Cells.description: Runs flows/scripts/PopulateAppraisalReviewCells.ts against the new file (added once to the file/library via Excel Online > Automate, see DEPLOYMENT.md). All parameters are passed as strings — see the script for why — with missing values coalesced to the literal 'Not Stated'.

Create_Sharing_Link.description: Generates a fresh link for this specific new file (unlike a shared tracker, every review is a distinct file, so there is no static link to reuse).

Build_Review_Summary.inputs: @concat(coalesce(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['streetAddress'], 'Address not stated'), ', ', outputs('Format_City_State'), ' — ', coalesce(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['occupancyType'], 'occupancy not stated'), ', collateral value ', if(equals(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['collateralAnalysisValue'], null), 'not stated', concat('$', string(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['collateralAnalysisValue']))))

Handle_Extraction_Failure.description: Fires if either the AI Builder prompt call or the JSON parse fails — most commonly a scanned/non-OCR'd PDF the prompt could not read, or a malformed prompt response. No file is created in this branch.

inputs.errorMessage: @coalesce(actions('Extract_With_AI_Builder')?['error']?['message'], 'The document could not be read. It may be a scanned image without a text layer, or in an unsupported format.')
inputs.extractionNotes: Extraction failed — no workbook was created.

Handle_Write_Failure.description: Fires if extraction succeeded but the file copy, cell population, or sharing-link step failed — most commonly a misconfigured templateFilePath/destinationFolderPath parameter, the Office Script not present on the copied file, or a sheet name mismatch ('RE Collateral').

inputs.errorMessage: @coalesce(actions('Populate_Review_Cells')?['error']?['message'], actions('Copy_Template_To_New_File')?['error']?['message'], actions('Get_New_File_Properties')?['error']?['message'], actions('Create_Sharing_Link')?['error']?['message'], 'The extracted data could not be written to a new workbook. Check the template/destination parameters and the Office Script.')
inputs.extractionNotes: Data was extracted from the PDF but the workbook could not be created/populated — see errorMessage.

aiBuilderPromptId.description: GUID of the 'Appraisal Review Field Extraction' AI Builder Prompt, created once per environment (see DEPLOYMENT.md Part B).

templateSiteUrl.description: SharePoint site that hosts the bank's own appraisal review template workbook (sheet 'RE Collateral'). Designate this to point at wherever your team actually keeps the template — this flow does not ship a template of its own.

templateFilePath.description: Server-relative path to the template file within templateSiteUrl, e.g. /sites/CreditRisk/Shared Documents/Templates/Appraisal Review Template.xlsx.

destinationSiteUrl.description: SharePoint site where completed, per-review workbooks should be saved. Can be the same site as the template or a different one.

destinationFolderPath.description: Server-relative destination folder path within destinationSiteUrl, e.g. /sites/CreditRisk/Shared Documents/Appraisal Reviews.
